name: Consumer

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: CONSUMER: Growth trends sustaining; inflation to test margins
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Staples revenue growth improved QoQ with double-digit growth at some companies, but input inflation cut gross margin by 200-500bp at most (MARICO the outlier, +600bp on softer copra); NEST, ITC FMCG and BRIT grew 17-20%. In alcobev, UBBL volumes rose 16% with EBITDA margin up 390bp to 10.3%, RDCK P&A volume/value grew 36%/39% (EBITDA +50%), UNSP volumes fell 5%. In paints, a 2.5-3% price rise drove revenue, RM costs rose 28% YoY at APNT, gross margin contracted 350-650bp and EBITDA grew only 4% (APNT) and 3% (PIDI); sector revenue growth was 12% (staples), 18% (paints), 12% (liquor).

unit_economics: EBITDA = revenue (volume x price x mix, net of trade schemes) x (gross margin - A&P% - staff% - freight% - royalty/other%); price is passed through RM with a 1-3 quarter lag

price_drivers.why: Staples multiples (30-45x P/E) are paid for volume; HUL UVG ran 0-6% for 13 quarters and a 5% print against 6-8% expected moved the stock.

price_drivers.driver: Input cost inflation vs price taken
price_drivers.why: Palm, crude derivatives, copra, TiO2 and VAM set gross margin; paints GM fell 350-650bp in 2QFY27 while hikes of 12-17% were still being absorbed.
Managements guide bands (HUL 22-24%, APNT 18-20%, MRCO 22-24%); a quarter at the band edge decides EPS revisions.
Q-commerce and D2C entrants and Birla Opus in paints force A&P and scheme spend that compress margin.
Prestige-and-above spirits (RDCK P&A +36% volume) and premium paints lift realisation faster than volume.

kpis.name: Underlying volume growth
kpis.definition: Like-for-like volume or tonnage growth on the company's own definition, ex acquisitions and demergers
kpis.formula: reported (UVG/USG split); price growth = (1 + value growth) / (1 + volume growth) - 1
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Volume is the part of growth that is earned and compounds; price-led growth reverses when RM eases. GST 2.0 grammage changes inflate volume until the base laps in 3QFY27.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'volume growth' or 'UVG'; Motilal Oswal results update tables (8 quarters); transcripts for definition and base effects
kpis.estimate_source: No Bloomberg consensus for volume. Use Motilal Oswal and other broker models and management guidance (HUL, MRCO, APNT FY27 volume guidance on calls)
kpis.traps: Definition differs (HUL UVG includes mix; Britannia counts tonnes; Prataap counts packs); grammage cuts and GST destocking distort bases; APNT volume is largely tonnage incl. putty.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.definition: Revenue less materials, packing and traded goods, as % of revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: RM is 45-60% of revenue, so 100bp of GM is roughly 100bp of EBITDA margin when A&P is held; GM is the first line to show whether a price hike covered inflation.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (materials consumed, purchases of stock-in-trade, inventory change) for 5+ years; Motilal Oswal results tables for quarters; get_investor_presentation 'gross margin' (HUL stopped quoting it after Dec-2025, so derive it)
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates gives Sales, EBITDA, PAT, EPS only, so no GM consensus; use broker models (Motilal Oswal) and management GM-band language
kpis.traps: Revenue netting reclass (customer-spend moved to revenue deduction) changes GM% comparability; paints decks quote GM on net sales vs revenue; commodity inventory gains flatter a quarter.

kpis.name: Price taken vs RM inflation (pass-through ratio)
kpis.definition: Realised price growth divided by raw-material inflation over the same period
kpis.formula: realised price growth / RM inflation (calc); paints: cumulative price minus cumulative RM %
kpis.why_it_moves_price: A ratio near 1 holds GM%; about 0.5 holds gross profit rupees. Paints took 12-17% hikes against RM +28% (APNT) and VAM nearly doubling, so margin recovery in 3Q depends on further hikes (APNT +3.5% Nov, PIDI +3-5% Oct).
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation (APNT deck gives RM inflation and price action each quarter); transcripts for price hikes; get_commodity_prices for palm oil, crude, copra series
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; build from commodity assumptions (get_commodity_assumptions where covered), management price-hike commentary and broker RM trackers in the report library
kpis.traps: Announced vs weighted vs realised price differ; first quarter of a shock is cushioned by low-cost inventory, the second takes the hit; shrinkflation hides price.

kpis.name: EBITDA margin vs guided band
kpis.definition: EBITDA margin (ex other income) against the margin range management has guided
kpis.formula: EBITDA / revenue from operations; compare with band (HUL 22-24%, APNT 18-20%, MRCO 22-24%, PAGE double-digit volume)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Bands anchor EPS estimates; PAGE EBITDA margin 20.8% (-80bp) after a 270bp GM fall and an INDIGOPNTS EBITDA drop of 33% were the quarter's misses.
kpis.history_source: get_financials for annual EBITDA build; Motilal Oswal results tables (8 quarters); transcripts for band history
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg Sales and EBITDA for FY27-FY29; company guidance on calls
kpis.traps: APNT AR EBITDA includes other income (deck PBDIT does not); standalone vs consolidated; Ind AS 116; treasury income drives PAT beats.

kpis.name: A&P spend as % of revenue
kpis.definition: Advertising and sales promotion expense as % of revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: A&P is the lever managements pull when RM spikes; a cut flatters margin now and costs share later. UNSP's 4% EBITDA drop came from higher pre-festive A&P.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (annual report A&P note); get_investor_presentation 'A&P'; Motilal Oswal tables
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models and management A&P commentary; no Bloomberg field
kpis.traps: After the revenue-netting reclass, trade spend moves out of A&P; compare restated bases only.

kpis.name: Premium (P&A) volume and value growth
kpis.definition: Growth in prestige-and-above spirits and premium beer volume and value; gross margin uplift from mix and price
kpis.formula: reported; P&A value growth - P&A volume growth shows realisation
kpis.why_it_moves_price: P&A carries higher gross margin than popular brands, so mix drives EBITDA: RDCK P&A +36%/+39% gave +50% EBITDA; UNSP popular volumes fell 30% against P&A -1%.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation 'P&A' or 'prestige' metric filter; transcripts; Motilal Oswal results tables
kpis.estimate_source: Company guidance (RDCK P&A volume growth guided 30% for FY27, EBITDA margin ~20%); broker models; consensus covers only Sales/EBITDA/PAT/EPS
kpis.traps: State excise price changes and route-to-market shifts; ENA, grain and glass cost lags; gross vs net revenue with excise.

kpis.name: Paints decorative volume-value gap
kpis.definition: Decorative volume growth minus value growth; shows price, mix and downtrading
kpis.why_it_moves_price: In 2QFY27 value outran volume because hikes of 2.5-3% went through; APNT decorative volume slowed to 6% (9% in 1Q on channel upstocking), so a narrowing gap signals price fatigue and Birla Opus share gain.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation (APNT, BERGEPAINT decks: decorative volume and value); transcripts; get_financials for consolidated revenue
kpis.estimate_source: Management volume guidance (APNT 8-9% FY27); broker models; Bloomberg Sales consensus only
kpis.traps: Pre-hike dealer stocking pulls volume forward (1QFY27, March); Berger volume is total tonnage incl. industrial; JSW Dulux growth is distorted by carve-out.

kpis.name: Channel mix and rural vs urban growth
kpis.definition: Share of sales and growth by general trade, modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce; rural growth relative to urban
kpis.formula: reported where disclosed; growth gap rural - urban (pp)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Rural outpaced urban in 2QFY27 and GT improved; q-commerce scaling raises trade spend and favours insurgents, so channel mix predicts gross margin and share.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation 'e-commerce' or 'quick commerce' filter; transcripts and get_qa for channel commentary; broker results updates
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; management commentary and Bizom/NielsenIQ data quoted in broker notes in the library
kpis.traps: Companies quote q-com on different bases; NielsenIQ excludes e-commerce and shows lower volume than reported.

macro_inputs.series: Monsoon, rural wages and food inflation

Jewellery SSSG and volume (easing gold lifted volumes in 2QFY27)

valuation_anchor: P/E on 1-2 year forward normalised EPS against own band (HUL, Nestle 45-60x; paints now ~40-49x), with EV/EBITDA for paints and alcobev as cross-check
watch_next_quarter: 3QFY27 gross margin once high-cost paints inventory is consumed, TiO2 anti-dumping duty and further hikes (APNT +3.5%, PIDI +3-5%), and whether staples take more price against RM; festive and wedding demand (first 40 days of 3Q strong in jewellery) and GST-benefit anniversary from 3Q.
